name: Fit to Print

categories.label: Round score (Fri/Sat/Sun)
categories.hint: Per round: articles + photos + centerpiece + white space (3 smallest / -1 largest / 1 others) - mood imbalance - 1 per unplaced tile. A round total below 0 counts as 0.

categories.label: Ad revenue ($)
categories.hint: Dollar signs on ads placed each round, summed. Lowest total is eliminated from winning. Not part of score.

categories.label: 2-player ad penalty
categories.hint: 2 players only: enter -10 if one player has more than $5 less ad revenue than the other (that player is still eligible).

tiebreakers.description: Tied on points: the player with the lower Finishing Token on Sunday wins

notes: family: point-salad-euro (3 rounds, per-round scoring). Winner: player(s) with the lowest total ad revenue are out of the running (not eligible); among the rest the highest total score wins. Enter each round's final score after clamping at 0. Solo/Puzzle mode and Breaking News/achievement modes not modelled. Ad-revenue elimination is not enforced by the calculator; apply manually.
